verses.en: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.pt: Ora, Sarai, mulher de Abrão, não lhe dava filhos. Tinha ela uma serva egípcia, que se chamava Agar.
verses.en_web: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.en_bbe: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had given him no children; and she had a servant, a woman of Egypt whose name was Hagar.

verses.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.pt: Disse Sarai a Abrão: Eis que o Senhor me tem impedido de ter filhos; toma, pois, a minha serva; porventura terei filhos por meio dela. E ouviu Abrão a voz de Sarai.
verses.en_web: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.en_bbe: And Sarai said to Abram, See, the Lord has not let me have children; go in to my servant, for I may get a family through her. And Abram did as Sarai said.

verses.en: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
verses.pt: Assim Sarai, mulher de Abrão, tomou a Agar a egípcia, sua serva, e a deu por mulher a Abrão seu marido, depois de Abrão ter habitado dez anos na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
verses.en_bbe: So after Abram had been living for ten years in the land of Canaan, Sarai took Hagar, her Egyptian servant, and gave her to Abram for his wife.

verses.en: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.pt: E ele conheceu a Agar, e ela concebeu; e vendo ela que concebera, foi sua senhora desprezada aos seus olhos.
verses.en_web: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.en_bbe: And he went in to Hagar and she became with child, and when she saw that she was with child, she no longer had any respect for her master's wife.

verses.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
verses.pt: Então disse Sarai a Abrão: Sobre ti seja a afronta que me é dirigida a mim; pus a minha serva em teu regaço; vendo ela agora que concebeu, sou desprezada aos seus olhos; o Senhor julgue entre mim e ti.
verses.en_web: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes. Yahweh judge between me and you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Sarai said to Abram, May my wrong be on you: I gave you my servant for your wife and when she saw that she was with child, she no longer had any respect for me: may the Lord be judge between you and me.

verses.en: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
verses.pt: Ao que disse Abrão a Sarai: Eis que tua serva está nas tuas mãos; faze-lhe como bem te parecer. E Sarai maltratou-a, e ela fugiu de sua face.
verses.en_web: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
verses.en_bbe: And Abram said, The woman is in your power; do with her whatever seems good to you. And Sarai was cruel to her, so that she went running away from her.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.pt: Então o anjo do Senhor, achando-a junto a uma fonte no deserto, a fonte que está no caminho de Sur,
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
verses.en_bbe: And an angel of the Lord came to her by a fountain of water in the waste land, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

verses.en: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.pt: perguntou-lhe: Agar, serva de Sarai, donde vieste, e para onde vais? Respondeu ela: Da presença de Sarai, minha senhora, vou fugindo.
verses.en_web: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's servant, where have you come from and where are you going? And she said, I am running away from Sarai, my master's wife.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe o anjo do Senhor: Torna-te para tua senhora, e humilha-te debaixo das suas mãos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
verses.en_bbe: And the angel said to her, Go back, and put yourself under her authority.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe mais o anjo do Senhor: Multiplicarei sobremaneira a tua descendência, de modo que não será contada, por numerosa que será.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
verses.en_bbe: And the angel of the Lord said, Your seed will be greatly increased so that it may not be numbered.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe ainda o anjo do Senhor: Eis que concebeste, e terás um filho, a quem chamarás Ismael; porquanto o Senhor ouviu a tua aflição.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel of the Lord said, See, you are with child and will give birth to a son, to whom you will give the name Ishmael, because the ears of the Lord were open to your sorrow.

verses.en: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.pt: Ele será como um jumento selvagem entre os homens; a sua mão será contra todos, e a mão de todos contra ele; e habitará diante da face de todos os seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposite all of his brothers.”
verses.en_bbe: And he will be like a mountain ass among men; his hand will be against every man and every man's hand against him, and he will keep his place against all his brothers.

verses.en: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.pt: E ela chamou, o nome do Senhor, que com ela falava, El-Rói; pois disse: Não tenho eu também olhado neste lugar para aquele que me vê?
verses.en_web: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
verses.en_bbe: And to the Lord who was talking with her she gave this name, You are a God who is seen; for she said, Have I not even here in the waste land had a vision of God and am still living?

verses.en: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.pt: Pelo que se chamou aquele poço Beer-Laai-Rói; ele está entre Cades e Berede.
verses.en_web: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.en_bbe: So that fountain was named, Fountain of Life and Vision: it is between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.pt: E Agar deu um filho a Abrão; e Abrão pôs o nome de Ismael no seu filho que tivera de Agar.
verses.en_web: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.en_bbe: And Hagar gave birth to a child, the son of Abram, to whom Abram gave the name of Ishmael.

verses.en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.pt: Ora, tinha Abrão oitenta e seis anos, quando Agar lhe deu Ismael.
verses.en_web: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.en_bbe: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar gave birth to Ishmael.
